title: VTC Roles — Delete — payload
description: Delete a custom administrative role that no ACL entry holds. Built-in roles are not deletable. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

name.description: Name of the custom role to delete.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded with the deletion and shown to approvers.

Response.title: VTC Roles — Delete — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/roles/delete/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/roles/delete/0.1#response.

deleted.description: The name of the role that was deleted.
